title: local model host for a team

clauses.text: a team's local model host (for example Ollama) answers one chat message through the team's entry

steps.do: On a machine that runs the local model host, add its entry for the team with its address, then press the health or test button.
steps.expect: The entry shows its health state. Send one chat message with that model.

steps.do: Send messages from two people at once when the limit is one per person.
steps.expect: The second message waits in the queue, and the reply comes from the host.
